title: Mowing & Trimming Services at Thomson Causeway Recreation Area
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION MISSISSIPPI VALLEY.ENDIST ROCK ISLAND.W07V ENDIST ROCK ISLAND
detail_text: The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) - Rock Island District intends to issue a solicitation for mowing and trimming services at Thomson Causeway Recreation Area in Thomson, Illinois. This is a pre-solicitation notice and is NOT a request for quotations. The contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials/supplies, transportation and fuel to perform mowing and trimming services at Thomson Causeway Recreation Area. Additional information on requirement will be provided when solicitation is released.
